description: Na₂Se₂O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SeO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.38 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six SeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.79 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  a cornercorner with one SeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-56°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.78 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  a cornercorner with one SeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-56°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.83 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two Se atoms.
